entities.summary: Saint Irene (Erina) in Catholicism known as Irene of Lecce and in Orthodox Christianity as Irene of Macedonia (Αγία Ειρήνη η Μεγαλομάρτυς) was a pre-congregation saint, Great Martyr, said to have lived sometime during the 1st or 2nd century.
